title: 🔥 THE PARABLE OF THE SHEEP AND THE GOATS – WILL YOU BE ACCEPTED OR REJECTED? 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 THE PARABLE OF THE SHEEP AND THE GOATS – WILL YOU BE ACCEPTED OR REJECTED? 🔥
📖 Matthew 25:31-33 – "When the Son of Man comes in His glory, and all the angels with Him, He will sit on His glorious throne. All the nations will be gathered before Him, and He will separate the people one from another as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats. He will put the sheep on His right and the goats on His left."

❓ QUESTION FROM A READER:
"Brother John, I heard about the parable of the Sheep and the Goats, but I don’t fully understand it. What does it mean? How do I know if I am a sheep or a goat?"
🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! This parable is a prophecy about Judgment Day. Many believe they are saved, but on that day, Jesus will separate the true believers (sheep) from the false ones (goats).
🚨 The terrifying reality? Many churchgoers will be SHOCKED to hear Jesus say, "I never knew you!" (Matthew 7:23).
Are you truly saved, or just religious? Let’s break this down BIBLICALLY!

🔥 1. WHAT DOES THE PARABLE MEAN?
📖 Matthew 25:34 – "Then the King will say to those on His right, ‘Come, you who are blessed by My Father; take your inheritance, the kingdom prepared for you since the creation of the world.’"
🔥 In this parable, Jesus describes what will happen when He returns:

✔️ He will sit on His throne as King and Judge.
✔️ All nations will be gathered before Him.
✔️ He will separate people into two groups: the sheep (His true followers) and the goats (the false believers).
🚨 This is the FINAL SEPARATION! No more chances, no more excuses.
💡 The question is—where will YOU stand?

🔥 2. WHO ARE THE SHEEP? (THE TRUE FOLLOWERS OF CHRIST)
📖 John 10:27 – "My sheep listen to My voice; I know them, and they follow Me."
🔥 The Sheep represent the TRUE Christians who:

✔️ Obey Jesus and live according to His teachings.
✔️ Have a genuine love for others, especially the poor and needy.
✔️ Serve Christ by serving others (Matthew 25:35-36).
💡 These are the ones Jesus will WELCOME into His kingdom!
🚨 But what about the goats? This is where many get deceived…

🔥 3. WHO ARE THE GOATS? (THE FALSE BELIEVERS)
📖 Matthew 25:41 – "Then He will say to those on His left, ‘Depart from Me, you who are cursed, into the eternal fire prepared for the devil and his angels.’"
🔥 The Goats represent FAKE Christians who:

❌ Claim to follow Jesus but ignore His commands.
❌ Have no real love for others, especially the poor and suffering.
❌ Think that attending church or doing religious acts is enough.
❌ Reject opportunities to serve Christ through others.
🚨 Jesus will REJECT THEM on Judgment Day, because they NEVER truly followed Him!
💡 Going to church doesn’t make you a sheep—OBEDIENCE TO CHRIST DOES!

🔥 4. WHAT SEPARATES SHEEP FROM GOATS? (OBEDIENCE VS. DISOBEDIENCE)
📖 1 John 3:18 – "Let us not love with words or speech but with actions and in truth."
🔥 The difference between Sheep and Goats is not what they SAY, but what they DO!

✔️ Sheep live out their faith by loving and serving others.
✔️ Goats talk about faith, but their lives show no real change.
🚨 Faith without works is DEAD! (James 2:26)
💡 Are you just TALKING about Jesus, or are you LIVING for Him?

🔥 5. REAL-LIFE TESTIMONY – A "GOAT" WHO BECAME A SHEEP!
A man spent years in church but lived a sinful life outside of it. He never helped the poor, never cared about the suffering, and only prayed when he needed something.
🔥 One day, he read Matthew 25 and realized he was a "goat"—a fake believer. He repented, surrendered fully to Christ, and started living out his faith by serving others.
🚨 Now, he is not just a churchgoer—he is a TRUE disciple of Christ!
💡 Will YOU be a sheep or a goat on Judgment Day?

🔥 FINAL WARNING: SHEEP ENTER HEAVEN, GOATS GO TO HELL!
📖 Matthew 25:46 – "Then they will go away to eternal punishment, but the righteous to eternal life."
🚨 This is the FINAL SEPARATION. No appeals. No second chances.

🔥 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?
❌ Continue living a selfish, religious life?
✔️ Surrender fully to Christ and start walking in obedience?
🚨 CHOOSE NOW—BECAUSE JUDGMENT DAY IS COMING!

🙏 PRAYER FOR TRUE SALVATION
"Lord Jesus, I surrender my life to You completely. I don’t want to just be religious—I want to truly follow You! Transform me from a ‘goat’ into one of Your sheep. Fill me with Your Spirit and lead me in obedience. In Jesus’ name, AMEN!"
